summarize_run_dump: summarize the hermes CLI dump command that outputs a compact plain-text setup summary for support context
run_dump_status: run the dump command to generate a copy-pasteable hermes environment status report
review_gateway_status: review the gateway status helper that reports running, stopped, or unknown state with pid and manager mode
review_config_overrides: review the config overrides helper that compares user config values against defaults and returns interesting differences
review_configured_platforms: review the configured platforms helper that checks environment variables to determine which messaging platforms are set up
